context_requirements: The cell line must express the relevant vitamin B transporter or enzyme target.
The drug must be present at a concentration sufficient to inhibit or modulate the target.
The target pathway must be active or required for a transcriptional response.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent change in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines.
A consistent transcriptional signature shared across multiple cell lines that matches a known vitamin B deficiency or inhibition response.
Changes in expression of direct target genes or known downstream metabolic genes.
